name: GPU Mesh Voxelization (Schwarz & Seidel 2010)
aliases: GPU Mesh Voxelization via Compute Shaders
definition: A GPU-accelerated algorithm to convert a triangle mesh into a set of occupied voxel coordinates within a 3D grid. It uses a bit-packed voxel table to mark occupied cells and a sparse extraction kernel to retrieve coordinates.
summary: GPU Mesh Voxelization converts triangle meshes to voxel grids using explicit geometric intersection tests on the GPU, distinguishing itself from rasterization-based methods by avoiding hardware projection.
